visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a modern, brightly lit office space. Ian, a man in a light green button-up shirt, is sitting at a desk with two computer monitors. A woman off-camera asks him about his plans for Friday night. (2) Ian stands up and interacts with several colleagues in a common area. The background features a large wall graphic with the text "THE DODO MEN" and "DON'T JUST DREAM IT." He uses frequent hand gestures while talking and laughing. (3) The group gathers around a gray table for a discussion. The lighting is uniform and bright studio-style. Various office items, like laptops and a vase with branches, are visible on the surfaces. Text captions in Traditional Chinese appear frequently to highlight the dialogue. (4) A large, silver gift box with green accents and the Heineken logo is presented on the table. Ian stands at the center, looking at the box with curiosity. His hands are on the lid, ready to open it. (5) Ian opens the box, which has a built-in mirror on the underside of the lid. Inside are two bottles of Heineken Silver beer and a silver pressurized canister. The team members lean in to look, their facial expressions showing surprise and excitement. (6) Ian picks up the silver canister, which is revealed to be a branded moisturizing lotion. He pumps some onto the back of his hand and rubs it in, demonstrating the product to his laughing colleagues. (7) The team gathers for a final celebratory moment. They each hold a bottle or can of Heineken Silver. They perform a synchronized toast in the middle of the frame, clinking their drinks together while smiling broadly at the camera.

(3) The vocal interaction becomes more complex with multiple voices overlapping in a cheerful banter. Several cartoon-style 'pop' and 'boing' sound effects are inserted to match the variety-show editing style. The BGM maintains a consistent, energetic tempo. (4) The acoustic environment picks up physical sounds of a large box being slid on a table, followed by a soft percussive thud as the lid is opened. The crowd's vocal arousal increases with enthusiastic 'ohhh' and 'wow' reactions. (5) A distinct pressurized 'psst' sound occurs as the lotion pump is depressed. Ian and others express surprise through rising intonation. The BGM continues smoothly, bridging the dialogue and the physical sound events. (6) The video ends with a loud, ringing 'clink' of glass and cans during a group toast, accompanied by cheering and laughter. The background music volume swells briefly before a final hard cut to silence.
